name: claude-code-monitor
description: Claude Code Monitor, skill-map and session-pane:Claude Code plugins by Ben Bellborn.

plugins.name: ccm
plugins.description: A live window with one card per Claude Code session: what it runs, if it waits on you, its statusline.

plugins.name: skill-map
plugins.description: Draws a zoomable map of your Claude Code skills, hooks, mods and plugins: which md files, agents and tools each command pulls in, and where tokens can be saved.

plugins.name: session-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that shows what the session does now: denied permissions, changed files with their diffs, running agents and background tasks, and the open tasks of your TODO file.
